Plans & itineraries

Preparation & general FAQ

This page summarises what to prepare and common questions, honestly separating fact from what must be confirmed.

Updated · 28 Oktober 2026

Packing

Before departure

Prepare sun/rain protection, drinking water, beach footwear, and travel documents.

  • Check the official forecast.
  • Prepare small cash.
  • Note land points if water activities are cancelled.

Confirm

On site

Ask staff about retribution, parking, boats, and activities. Do not assume outdated information still applies.

Not official

This guide is an independent non-commercial third party; not an official, government, or ticketing site.

Common questions

Questions

Before you go

01What should I bring?+

Weather protection, drinking water, beach footwear, and documents. Check the forecast before leaving.

02Is this guide official?+

No. This is an independent non-commercial third-party guide, not an official, government, or ticketing site.

03Where to confirm prices?+

Ask staff at the gate and jetty; rates can change.

04If info differs from a sign?+

Follow the official notice board and staff on site; this guide is not a substitute.
